title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Tier on Which a Resumption Deposit Is Figured
content:
**Admissions deposit note, returns to private pay — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The resumption deposit tier follows the room the resident is billed for now.

| Records | Resumption deposit tier |
|---|---|
| The agreement's room-and-board span that begins latest (the one posted first where two begin on the same day) begins on or after the conversion date recorded on the agreement | That span's tier |
| No such span is posted, and the agreement carries an isolation placement | The isolation billing tier of the agreement's tier, what the resident pays while placed there |
| Neither | The tier of the agreement's admission-month charge |

| Agreement's tier | Its isolation billing tier |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |

**Points of judgement.** A latest span that began the day before the recorded conversion date does not qualify under the first row.
